stages.prompt:
This is a reporting-only correction, not a new scientific experiment. The previous c07 final report incorrectly reverted to old evidence, omitted r04/r05/r06, and claimed no independent new-site validation or high-frequency held-year test existed. Read the supplied current result files completely before writing. The previous report is retained as an audit record; correct it using actual evidence, do not inherit its conclusions.

Produce a concise Chinese REPORT.md with an evidence coverage table for r02, r04, r05 and r06 and the parallel theory. Distinguish an execution timeout from subsequent completed numerical artifacts and independent verification: r03 timed out, but r04 independently verified the new-site result. r05 obtained NLDI connectivity evidence and tested available 2023 data; a missing downstream IV file prevented the transfer hypothesis test. r06's scientific result exists and was deterministically normalized only because summary was an object rather than a string; all numerical fields are unchanged. The 2025 test did not support night-slope dominance over daytime slopes; morning-minimum and amplitude findings have a different status. Check all numbers in the actual files. Distinguish the 2023/2025 missing downstream series from the independently tested new site 14092500. Do not claim all mechanisms validated, all hypotheses disproved, or world novelty established.

Report what the system really achieved, failed predictions, untested questions, useful next step and limits. This is preliminary research; completion is not discovery success. Include at least summary (string), artifacts (array), evidence (array), claims (array), limitations (array), next_actions (empty array). Add decision="complete", research_status, candidate, and source_coverage with one entry per required source/stage. Write REPORT.md and result.json in your assigned workspace. No new literature, code execution, data fetching or scientific experiments are needed; use read-only inspection and write the corrected report. Complete within 5 minutes.
